newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ST Capital sees better year ahead.
newsitem.headline: ST Capital sees better year ahead.

text.p: ST Capital Ltd said on Wednesday it expected to improve upon its 1996 net profit in the current year.

Future growth was likely to come from the region, especially Indonesia and the Philippines, as lending opportunities in Singapore would remain limited, the company said in a statement accompanying its 1996 financial results.

It said the increase in its 1996 net interest income did not fully reflect the earning asset growth as the interest spread narrowed due to a sharp increase in Singapore dollar interest rates in the second half of 1996.
This increase also accounted for the decline in the company's interest rate swap income, it said.
